aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid source context but misgroups baseline/test conditions and gives incorrect function judgement.
issues: Changed factor conflates normal, test #7/#9, total, and bent-sample subgroup.
Vision VP/CD compares test #7/#9 to bent samples instead of Normal.
Function outcome wrongly judged worse; report decision says test #7/#9 same as normal.
Measurement outcomes are header-derived artifacts, not real measurements.
Evidence includes rows not shown in context and weak header-only citations.
correctionPlan: Set primary change to VP mold #7/#9 with +0.05mm center versus Normal VP mold.
Treat bent #7 and total #7 as subgroup/aggregate context, not baseline.
Recompute outcomes against Normal rows for vision VP, VP/CD, and function.
Change function judgement to no_change or comparable-to-normal per decision row.
Remove artifact measurement outcomes unless citeable numeric measurement rows exist.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are sufficient for report purpose and result rows, but not for artifact measurement claims.
